name: Veerkrupa Jewellers Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2019, Veerkrupa Jewellers Ltd is in the business of retailing and wholesaling of jewellery.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
a) VKJL sells jewellery made from gold, silver, and studded materials.
b) The company's product range includes items featuring:
 - Diamonds
- Platinum
- Other precious and semi-precious stones
c) Its design portfolio covers designer, traditional, modern, and hybrid jewellery styles.
d) The company sells its products in the northeast of central Ahmedabad- Naroda and Narol, and the adjoining areas. 
e) Its gold jewellery is hallmarked by BIS except gold jewellery weighing less than 2 grams, which is not required to be hallmarked.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.75 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 1.35% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -22.7%
